title: Albany Road
description:
S1 E1
On her way to the most important meeting of her career, a New York executive is forced to share a rental car with her ex-fiancé's mother, only to discover that the mother is hiding a major secret.

title: Beyond The Lights
description:
S1 E1
The pressures of fame have superstar singer Noni on the edge until she meets Kaz, a young cop who works to help her find the courage to develop her own voice and break free to become the artist she was meant to be.

title: Down in the Delta
description:
S1 E1
In Maya Angelou's directorial debut, a troubled single mother spends the summer at her family's ancestral home in rural Mississippi and learns to reverse the downward slide of her life in this uplifting story of family, community and friendship.

title: The Inspection
description:
S1 E1
Rejected by his mother and with few options, a young, gay Black man joins the Marines, doing whatever it takes to succeed in a system that would cast him aside, unexpectedly finding camaraderie, strength, and support in this new community.

title: Love Jones
description:
S1 E1
In this sweet, comic romance set against the jazz rhythms of Chicago, two educated, upscale urban artists discover modern courtship as they both experience a Love Jones.

title: House Party
description:
S1 E1
When party time comes, it's time to tear the house down! If they get caught, it's all over. But if they don't, it's just the beginning! Kid 'N Play stars in the uproarious comedy that launched the House Party craze.

title: House Party 2
description:
S1 E1
High school is over, but the party is not. Join Kid n' Play for a hip-hop college adventure in House Party 2. Kid decides to pursue college, but when Play loses Kid's tuition money, the two boys have to devise a new plan -the wildest one yet!
